name: Crofter Donald

intro.text: I've been out since five, rounding up sheep that think they're being followed. They are. By me. Fancy a battle? It'll give them a rest.

win: Well done. I'll away and count my sheep again.
after: A croft is a small farm, usually twenty acres or so, and the crofter has security of tenure by law. In other words: the landlord can't throw us off. That wasn't always so, and the islands remember.
